formulas.name: formula_error_num_of_payment
formulas.expression: IF({!Number_of_Payments} > 0, {!tt_scheduled_total_not_matching_error}, "Number of Payments must be greater than 0")

formulas.name: formula_skip_weekend
formulas.expression: CASE( MOD( {!Start_Date}- DATE(1900, 1, 7), 7), 0, {!Start_Date}+1, /*if varInputDate is Sun,varInputDate+1=Monday */ 6,{!Start_Date}+2, /*if varInputDate is Sat,varInputDate+2=Monday next week */ {!Start_Date}) /*if varInputDate is not a weekend, varInputDate remains unchanged*/

formulas.name: formulaSettlementAgreementSummaryAdd
formulas.expression: {!formulaLineBreak} + TEXT({!varPaymentNum}) + " " + {!varFrequency} + " payments of $" + TEXT({!varAmount}) + " starting " + TEXT({!varStartDate}) + " (" + {!Method_of_Payment} +")"

formulas.name: formulaSettlementAgreementSummaryFirst
formulas.expression: "Settlement Agreement: $" + TEXT({!var_remaining_settlement_total}) + {!formulaLineBreak} + TEXT({!varPaymentNum}) + " " + {!varFrequency} + " payments of $" + TEXT({!varAmount}) + " starting " + TEXT({!varStartDate}) + " (" + {!Method_of_Payment} +")"
